checks.q: Is the funding rate calculation resistant to manipulation?
Is the mark price oracle protected against manipulation?
Are position sizes validated against open interest caps?
Is the liquidation engine resistant to cascading liquidation attacks?
Are profit and loss calculations atomic and consistent?
Is the insurance fund properly managed and funded?
Are leverage limits enforced consistently across all operations?
Is the ADL (Auto-Deleveraging) mechanism fair and resistant to gaming?
Are cross-margin and isolated margin modes correctly isolated?
Is the order matching engine resistant to front-running?
Are fees calculated correctly on leveraged positions?
Is delayed order execution protected against oracle manipulation?
Are partial liquidations implemented correctly?
Is the protocol resistant to market manipulation via self-trading?
Are keeper incentives aligned to prevent delayed liquidations?
Is the maximum price impact properly bounded per trade?
Are position modifications (increase/decrease) handled atomically?
Is the protocol safe against price gap attacks between epochs?
Are withdrawal cooldowns enforced after depositing to vault/LP?
Is the protocol's total exposure bounded relative to available liquidity?
